title: Prototype clip briefing
passage: This shelf holds several versions of the same clip. The blue clips are for today’s fit check, not for shipment. The white clips have already been checked against the drawing. Keep those in the covered tray until assembly asks for them. If a blue clip fits, mark the result on the worksheet; do not swap it into the covered tray. We need to compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings before we release any more clips. If you find a loose clip without a label, leave it in the empty bin so we can identify its version later.
passageZh: 這個架子上有同一種卡扣的多個版本。藍色卡扣用於今天的試裝，不是要出貨。白色卡扣已與圖面核對完畢，請留在有蓋托盤，等組裝部門來取。如果藍色卡扣裝得上，請把結果登記在工作表，不要把它換到有蓋托盤裡。放行更多卡扣前，我們還需要比較工作表和列印機的設定。若發現一個散放、沒有標籤的卡扣，請放到空料盒，方便稍後辨認版本。
